content:
maria: ShadowBox needs an assurance bundle for their POC: a short SOC2 excerpt (storage + access controls), a signed vulnerability attestation, a redacted network diagram, and permission for their external scanner to hit our staging. Also asked whether presigned URLs or ephemeral KMS creds change Dedicated pricing.

ezra: I can pull the SOC2 pages and do a redacted diagram. For uploads we provide presigned S3 URLs by default (24h). Example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/shadowbox/drop.zip --expires-in 86400`.

olivia: Security requirements: signed NDA, named test window, staging-only, IP allowlist, scoped bucket prefix. No persistent service creds; only presigned URLs or short-lived STS/API keys which must be rotated after test. Ops needs ~24-48h to provision/revoke keys.

ops-bot: Checklist -> attach SOC2 excerpt PDF, redacted diagram, attestation-template.docx. Approvals needed: Security + Legal.

harper (Legal): I'll review the attestation wording. We should avoid promising remediation timelines in the attestation; reference standard SLAs instead. Turnaround: ~2 business days after draft.

jake (CISO): I can sign once Legal clears wording. Attestation will state scope, allowed IPs, test window, and consent to the scan. No extra liability commitments.

maria: Pricing on presigned URLs?

ezra: No pricing change for standard presigned URLs or short-lived tokens. Anything requiring VPC peering, dedicated gateway, or sustained high-volume scan traffic may require a quote or will be billed as normal usage. I'll draft a short pricing blurb to attach.

maria: Plan: get NDA + tester CV/IPs, draft attestation + pricing blurb, send to customer by Fri EOD. @olivia draft attestation, @ezra pricing note, @harper legal review, @jake final sign-off.

(attachments planned: SOC2-excerpt-storage.pdf, redacted-diagram-v1.png, attestation-draft.docx)
